name: compact-summary-reasoning
title: Compact summary must not carry reasoning content into a user message
description: SDK generateSummary copies the model's full response content (including reasoningBlock thinking blocks) into a role:user summary message; with darwin's always-on adaptive thinking Bedrock then rejects requests with 'User messages cannot contain reasoning content', /compact logs 'proactive summarization failed' and the persisted session may be poisoned. Fix in the pinned SDK patch by stripping reasoning blocks from the summary message, add a free regression test, and repair already-poisoned histories.
creator: river
